name: Buffet Reither Kogel
kurzbeschreibung:
**Buffet Reither Kogel in Tirol**

Discover the breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps** at the **Buffet Reither Kogel**, perched high above **Innsbruck** at 1,800 meters. Enjoy hearty Austrian dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain trout, paired with crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of local **Graubündner wine**. The cozy alpine setting offers panoramic vistas of snow-capped peaks and lush valleys—perfect for a relaxing break after a hike or ski adventure. Whether you're craving a warm **Apfelstrudel** or a savory **Schweinsbraten**, this rustic buffet is a must-visit for food lovers and nature enthusiasts alike. Don’t forget to try their famous **Topfenknödel** for a taste of authentic **Tiroler** comfort food!
